paper: Yan et al. (2015), International Journal of Astrobiology 14, 255; accepted manuscript arXiv:1405.4780v1 (2014)
source_status: Seven native-raster readouts of the observed black curve; not an author-released numerical table, not original exposures, not model samples
license: Digitized native-raster readouts of the cited publication's Figure 15 (scientific facts, not author-released data); no separate licence statement exists for figure readouts — used with full attribution; original figure copyright the publisher.

figure_image.black_pixel_definition: Each of R, G, B is less than 80 (8-bit channels); colored model and residual curves are excluded
figure_image.origin: Top left of native embedded image

measurement: Same near-Tycho lunar region's umbral count spectrum U1 divided by bright-Moon count spectrum B2, divided by exposure-time ratio 1800/6=300
normalization: Fig. 15 already includes exposure-time correction and is approximately lunar-surface E_lambda/F_lambda. Do NOT divide these points by 300 again. Sec. 5.3 gives this normalization explicitly; Fig. 3 uses a different count-ratio scale.
spectrograph: HRS at the Xinglong 2.16 m telescope, R approximately 45000, original coverage 430-1000 nm
lunar_target: Same region near Tycho crater throughout; exact fibre selenographic coordinate not tabulated
reduction: Bias, flat, extraction and background correction; 77 echelle orders combined. Same-region U1/B2 cancels solar spectrum, lunar spectral albedo and instrument response under stable observing conditions. Local telluric absorption is assumed to cancel at a mean-airmass difference of 0.04; the authors explicitly note water-vapour variability as an exception. No absolute flux calibration was applied.
geometry_status: Completed conditional model comparison: DE441/high-precision lunar-site geometry over full U1 exposure, independently checked against Fig.1; exact fibre location remains unknown.
geometric_context: Paper Sec. 3.2 and Figs. 1, 5, 6 show a moving near-Tycho footprint; the low-tangent-point trajectory is near 156 E, 67 S at midpoint. The paper's single effective tangent altitude is a fitted/model-derived quantity, not an independently measured lunar shadow coordinate.
readout_definition: Median neutral-black stroke pixel across seven native image columns (about +/-0.62 nm); vertical allowance is full stroke/bin excursion from that median plus 2 pixels, converted to log10 units using 375 pixels per decade. This allowance describes figure readout only, NOT observational error, a confidence interval, or an independent-exposure count.
missing_information: Original reduced numerical spectrum and exposure-level calibration products
Pointwise observational uncertainties and spectrophotometric systematic uncertainty
Exact fibre coordinates and any tracking error during U1/B2
A full-width visible filter response or full spectrum suitable for an observed colorimetric integral
independence: Distinct lunar eclipse from the June 2011 reference, but these seven readouts come from one integrated December exposure and are not independent atmospheric realizations
